title: VIXEN recipe SIMD consumer cannot request MaterialId output channel
body: VIXEN CMake directly invokes --recipe-simd-cpp without an output-channel or material-carry contract, while provider service lowering supports outputChannels={7}; the generated RecipeSimd.g.hpp silently emits one distance output even when the material program is present, so BakeRegistryToPool cannot produce stored material samples. Consolidate a supported --recipe-simd-cpp MaterialId output contract and drift guard.

title: Queued VIXEN builds need durable per-lane build-tree admission and repair
body: The first queued build failed because the lane .tmp/build dependency tree was missing; reconfiguration through the live queue repaired it, and identical commands were then refused by the queue diagnostic breaker until UT_QUEUE_BREAKER=0. The supported lane workflow should expose scoped build-tree recovery and stable queue identity without manual environment overrides.

title: VIXEN UI target tests need a canonical staged-asset working directory
body: Running test_ui_kit and test_panel_dock_documents from the repository root made relative UI assets unavailable and caused failures/segfaults; the same targets passed from their staged asset working directory. Test targets should set their canonical working directory or provision assets automatically.
